note: Cases built from fixtures run through `orb validate --json` (the Rust check): beacon URLs (relative, other scheme, http, upper case, binding, empty), beacon requests (missing, without text, unknown keys, not an object) and options (unknown key, key in both), page-facts lists (unknown word, a fact twice, empty, not a list, binding, number) and the on-device effects (response schema, arity, options). The collector answer is the HOST_CALLS_COLLECTED the shared collector gives for the same program.
